title: Parliamentary Rivalries — Who Hates Whom (from Hansard + media + criminal/ethics records)
description: Maps personal rivalries, institutional feuds, and mutual vulnerabilities between parliamentarians. Each feud includes specific leverage points and email campaign integration notes.

active_feuds.history: Poilievre lost Carleton in 2025 election — won Battle River-Crowfoot by-election Aug 2025 — kept CPC leadership with 87.4% support at 2026 convention. The humiliation of losing his own seat fuels personal vendetta against Carney. Attacked Carney on conflict of interest before he even entered politics. Squared off in first QP of 2026 over food prices. Accused Carney's staff of removing grocery price tags during photo op.
active_feuds.leverage_for_poilievre: Send the FULL Brookfield dossier (50B Maple Fund, 95% unscreened, NorthRiver direct lobbying, BlackRock wife appointment). He already wants this ammo — give him BETTER ammo than he has. Include P4 (PM Divestiture Act) as 'concrete policy demand that sounds reasonable to voters.'
active_feuds.leverage_for_carney: Poilievre is ONLY party leader who refused NSICOP security clearance. What is he hiding? CPC leadership races infiltrated by foreign interference per NSICOP. Del Mastro (CPC) is ONLY MP convicted of election fraud. Include P2 (Foreign Lobbying Transparency) framed as 'strengthening C-70.'

dirt_cross_reference.poilievre: mp_criminal_ethics_dossier.json — security clearance refusal, RCMP 'despicable', caucus bullying

active_feuds.history: Lantsman accused government of being held captive by NDP. Called Palestinian statehood motion rewarding Hamas for a massacre. Joly claimed no arms permits since Oct 7 — which our data proves false (78.8M GD contract, 37.2M new permits, 18.9M shipped).
active_feuds.leverage_for_lantsman: Send the PROOF that Joly lied about arms permits. She already hates Joly — give her the GD contract timeline showing the 2-week contradiction. Lantsman attacks Joly. Joly is exposed. The arms pause fraud becomes public record.
active_feuds.leverage_for_joly: Lantsman has 18 CIJA meetings — highest of any CPC MP. She broke neutrality on Israel/Palestine because CIJA lobbied her. Foreign lobbying drove her parliamentary behaviour. Include P2 (Foreign Lobbying Transparency).

active_feuds.history: Housefather voted NAY on Gaza ceasefire breaking Liberal party line. Only 3 Liberals did this. He is CIJA most-lobbied MP at 87 meetings. His rebellion makes him a target within his own party.
active_feuds.leverage_for_liberal_whips: Send Liberal whips the CIJA meeting count data. 87 meetings with a foreign lobbying org that broke party line on the exact issue the org lobbied about. This is the lobby-to-vote pipeline in one person. If Liberals push P2, it catches Housefather.
active_feuds.leverage_for_housefather: CIJA lobbied 993 officials total. Housefather is not unique — he's just the most visible. Send him evidence of Liberal government hypocrisy on foreign influence (they passed C-70 but won't enforce it against CIJA). He becomes the champion of 'consistent enforcement.'

active_feuds.history: Genuis championed Uyghur genocide recognition in the House (passed 266-0). Woo led Senate opposition and killed it 33-29. Woo is UFWD-linked (576th org), has audio recordings of United Front promises. Espionage meeting 3 days before filing Senate challenge.
active_feuds.leverage_for_genuis: Send the FULL Woo dossier (UFWD link, audio recordings, espionage meeting). Genuis already hates Woo for killing the genocide motion. Give him the evidence that Woo was compromised. He becomes champion of P2 (Foreign Lobbying Transparency) + C-70 enforcement.
active_feuds.leverage_for_woo: None — Woo is the target, not an ally. The campaign uses Genuis as the weapon against Woo.

active_feuds.history: Pratt was Liberal Defence Minister, now lobbies DND for Raytheon + Israel Aerospace Industries (408 DND comms). CPC defence critics already oppose Liberal procurement. Pratt is the face of the revolving door.
active_feuds.leverage_for_cpc_defence: Send CPC defence committee members (James Bezan, etc.) the FULL Pratt revolving door analysis. Ex-Liberal minister lobbying his old department for foreign weapons manufacturers. They will make this a committee study. Include P3 (Revolving Door 10-year ban).

active_feuds.history: NDP collapsed from 25 to 7 seats in 2025. Lost party status for first time since 1993. Singh lost his own seat, resigned. Avi Lewis elected permanent leader March 2026. Only 7 MPs — every single one must differentiate themselves or the party dies. The supply-and-confidence deal (2022) that propped up the Liberals contributed to the collapse — voters saw NDP as Liberal enablers.
active_feuds.leverage_for_ndp: NDP with 7 seats has NOTHING left to lose and EVERYTHING to gain from anti-corruption positioning. Avi Lewis (grandson of David Lewis who coined 'corporate welfare bums') is genetically predisposed to champion corporate accountability reform. Don Davies was interim leader — already positioned on arms embargo. Give them the FULL lobbying picture + ethics enforcement failure. NDP becomes champion of P2 (transparency) and P3 (revolving door). Their survival depends on differentiation from Liberals — anti-corruption IS that differentiation.
active_feuds.leverage_for_liberals: NDP collapse means Liberal minority depends on Bloc (22 seats) for confidence votes. This makes Bloc the kingmaker — not NDP.
active_feuds.campaign_note: NDP with 7 seats is DESPERATE for relevance. Anti-corruption reform gives them a cause that gets media attention disproportionate to their size. Avi Lewis's family legacy makes him the perfect champion. Target Lewis directly with the full evidence package.

avi_lewis_hooks.his_own_words: Lewis said 'The cost of living emergency is driven by extreme wealth and power in the hands of the 1%' and proposed $40B/year wealth tax. He wants 'public ownership, worker power, climate justice.'
avi_lewis_hooks.align_with_cage: P2 (lobbying transparency) aligns perfectly with Lewis's anti-corporate messaging. P3 (revolving door ban) is literally about corporate capture. Frame the evidence as: 'Here's the proof that the corporate capture you campaign against is 100x worse than you knew. 359,251 lobbying contacts. Oil sector 10,794. Banking 7,497. This is the system you're fighting — and we have the data.'
avi_lewis_hooks.target_method: Lewis is NOT an MP. Target through Don Davies (Vancouver Kingsway) who was interim leader and is closest NDP MP to Lewis. Davies already positioned on arms embargo — give him the arms pipeline data AND the lobbying concentration data.

active_feuds.history: Jody Wilson-Raybould, first Indigenous AG, testified about PM pressure in SNC-Lavalin affair. Ethics commissioner found Trudeau guilty. Liberal response: expelled her AND Jane Philpott from caucus. Two of their most competent ministers destroyed for telling the truth.
active_feuds.leverage_universal: The Wilson-Raybould expulsion is the single most powerful narrative for the campaign. It proves: (1) the Liberal Party punishes whistleblowers and protects wrongdoers, (2) ethics violations have zero consequences while integrity has maximum consequences, (3) the system needs structural reform. Use in EVERY email to EVERY party as the cautionary tale.
active_feuds.campaign_note: Wilson-Raybould is no longer in Parliament but her story is the emotional core of the campaign. Every MP knows what happened to her. Every clean MP fears the same fate. The cage gives them protection.

active_feuds.history: Poilievre LOST HIS OWN SEAT in 2025 then won by-election to return. Despite 87.4% leadership review support, internal dissent is real — d'Entremont left caucus citing 'negative approach,' senior MPs called him 'a snake.' CPC is Official Opposition with 144 seats but Poilievre's personal defeat weakened his authority. 12.6% voted against him at convention. Backbenchers who survived the election feel emboldened — they won despite Poilievre losing.
active_feuds.leverage_for_clean_cpc_backbenchers: CPC backbenchers frustrated by Poilievre's autocratic style can use anti-corruption reforms to build independent profile. Roman Baber (already independent-minded, left Ford government) and Ellis Ross (Indigenous, anti-establishment) are prime targets. Frame: 'You can be the MP who championed accountability reform. That record survives any leadership change.'
active_feuds.campaign_note: The CPC internal tension is a gift. Frustrated backbenchers are more likely to table PMBs that their leadership doesn't control. This is how P1 and P4 get tabled.

dormant_rivalries.type: NDP wants arms embargo — Liberals maintain exports
dormant_rivalries.activation: Send Davies the full arms pipeline analysis. He becomes P5 (military oversight) champion.

dormant_rivalries.type: Green party excluded — May has 587 lobbying meetings, wants transparency
dormant_rivalries.activation: May got security clearance, read full NSICOP report. Says 'no list of disloyal current MPs' but demands Poilievre get clearance. Green Party formally asked if Poilievre 'owes favors to the Indian government.' May wants Hogue Inquiry recommendations adopted. She is THE moral authority amplifier — the only party leader who read the classified intel AND calls out Poilievre's refusal. Send her the full foreign influence data + CIJA deep analysis.

dormant_rivalries.type: Bloc wants Quebec autonomy — CIJA lobbied him 13 times
dormant_rivalries.activation: CRITICAL: Bloc with 22 seats is now KINGMAKER in Liberal minority (169 vs 172 needed). Liberals need Bloc for confidence votes since NDP has only 7. Blanchet ALREADY proved he will set ultimatums — in Sept 2024 he demanded OAS pension + supply management bills or he'd topple the government. He's transactional. Anti-corruption reform framed as 'Quebec demands Ottawa clean up' is exactly the kind of demand he'd make. Target Blanchet with the full evidence package — he can force reform as price of confidence.

blanchet_hooks.precedent: Blanchet set Oct 29 2024 deadline for Trudeau: pass Bloc bills or face confidence vote. He followed through — started talks with opposition to topple government. He WILL use his leverage.
blanchet_hooks.align_with_cage: Bloc's positioning is Quebec autonomy + clean government. P2 (lobbying transparency) frames as 'Ottawa lobbyists bypass Quebec interests.' P3 (revolving door) frames as 'Ottawa insiders enriching themselves at Quebec's expense.' Both are natural Bloc positioning.
blanchet_hooks.key_figure: Luc Theriault (Bloc vice-chair of ETHI) is the direct committee target. Simon-Pierre Savard-Tremblay (Bloc vice-chair of NDDN) is the defence committee swing vote. TWO Bloc MPs hold vice-chairs on the two committees the campaign targets.

dormant_rivalries.activation: ETHI members from ALL parties were frustrated by government refusal to surrender SDTC documents. Speaker ruled government in contempt. Any ETHI member can be recruited with: 'You voted to demand documents. They defied you. Here's the reform that gives committees actual enforcement power.'

feud_network_summary.most_weaponizable: F1 (Poilievre-Carney) — drives P4. F3 (Housefather-Liberal caucus) — drives P2. F5 (CPC defence-Pratt) — drives P3. F6 (NDP-Liberal) — drives P2+P3. F8 (CPC internal) — drives P1+P4.
